steps.intro: Already agreed: Off, Basic (no AI calls), and AI naming in assistant settings; a selectable naming model; turn-based AI reviews; user-chosen names always protected. Off keeps existing names. Basic makes a stable label from the opening request. These two choices finish the behavior before the visual preview.

steps.headline: Which naming mode should be selected before a user changes the setting?
steps.today: Native sessions ask their conversation model for a title. Claude Code sessions rely on a tool-use reminder. There is no shared naming-mode choice.
steps.problem: A default AI mode can make model requests before someone has chosen a naming model. A basic name is free of AI calls but less descriptive.
steps.proposal: Choose the starting mode for installations with no saved naming preference. Existing session names stay unchanged; users can select any mode later.

options.label: Basic
pros: Useful labels without AI calls or model setup.
AI naming becomes an explicit choice.
cons: New labels are less descriptive until AI naming is enabled.

options.label: AI
pros: Starts with model-generated summaries, using the conversation model until another is selected.
cons: Naming can incur provider charges without a separate model selection.

options.label: Off
pros: No automatic naming activity until the user enables it.
cons: New sessions need manual names to be easy to distinguish.

steps.headline: Should users be able to adjust how often AI names are reviewed?
steps.today: Native naming stops after a successful title. Claude Code reminders use elapsed time and tool activity, not completed replies.
steps.problem: Time does not measure how far the conversation has progressed. More frequent reviews can track changes sooner but make more model requests.
steps.proposal: Name after the first completed reply, refine after reply 3, then review every 25 completed replies. Tool steps do not count. Keep a name when it still fits. Choose whether that ongoing interval is adjustable.

options.label: Keep it automatic
pros: A predictable review every 25 completed replies after early refinement.
cons: Users cannot trade review frequency against naming cost.

options.label: Let users adjust
pros: Users can choose more frequent reviews or fewer model requests.
cons: Adds an interval control to AI naming settings.
